name: Hatzfeld (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Hatzfeld (Eder) (a red castle on white).
history: Municipal flag of Hatzfeld; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hatzfeld arms — red castle on white
